title: fusor-tokens config
description: Configuration for the fusor-tokens CLI. CSS variables only; light and dark themes.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL or path. The CLI writes ./node_modules/fusor-tokens/schema.json.

tokens.description: Globs for DTCG token JSON files, relative to the app root.

outFile.description: CSS file written by build. Fusor copies it when assets points at its directory.

engine.description: Token engine. MVP ships terrazzo. style-dictionary is reserved.

themeAttribute.description: HTML attribute that selects a theme. Default data-theme.

themes.description: Theme names. The first is the :root default. A theme named dark also emits the .dark class.

prefix.description: CSS variable prefix without leading dashes. ft becomes --ft-.
